```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
cell_id_1 <- "CX1"
cell_id_2 <- "CX2"

treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE

num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123

num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```

```{r}
cell_id_vec <- c("CX1", "CX2")
treated_vec <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
num_cells_before <- c(5415, 8123)
num_cells_after <- c(1432, 7543)
```

```{r}
cell_id <- c(cell_id_1, cell_id_2)
treated <- c(treated_1, treated_2)
n_before <- c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
n_after <- c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
```


```{r}
# for example
df <- tibble(
  cell_ID = c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  num_cells_before = c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after = c(1432, 7543)
)

gt(df)
```
